description_en: Generates virtual try-on images based on AI algorithms. This API service replaces the clothing on a model with the specified garment based on the input garment image and model image, while preserving the model's appearance details, pose, facial features, and scene details to achieve a realistic and well-fitted try-on result. You only need to provide the URL of the original product image to obtain a processed clean image
description_zh: 虚拟试穿是一款基于AI算法的图像生成类API服务，能够依据用户输入的服装图和模特图，将服装替换模特现有服装，保有模特的其他细节和画面细节，不改变模特动作、面容等，且实现服装上身的合理性和适配性。用户只需传入原始商品图URL，即可获得处理后的干净图片
name: VirtualTryOn

parameters.help_en: The URL of the model image. Only one image is supported. The URL must be a publicly accessible `http`/`https` address. The image must be in JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP, or WEBP format, with a resolution between 256 × 256 and 2049 × 2049 pixels, and a file size of no more than 10 MB.
parameters.help_zh: 模特图片 URL，仅支持1张，必须为 `http`/`https` 公网可访问地址，图像需是JPG、JPEG、PNG、BMP、WEBP格式的，分辨率应在256×256至2049x2049像素之间，文件大小不超过10MB
parameters.name: model_image_url

parameters.help_en: The URL of the garment image. Only one image is supported. The URL must be a publicly accessible `http`/`https` address. The image must be in JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP, or WEBP format, with a resolution between 256 × 256 and 2049 × 2049 pixels, and a file size of no more than 10 MB.
parameters.help_zh: 服装图片 URL，仅支持1张，必须为 `http`/`https` 公网可访问地址，图像需是JPG、JPEG、PNG、BMP、WEBP格式的，分辨率应在256×256至2049x2049像素之间，文件大小不超过10MB
parameters.name: cloth_image_url

parameters.help_en: The garment type. Valid values: tops, bottoms, dresses, tops_and_bottoms, shoes, and hats. If this parameter is not specified, the system automatically identifies the garment type
parameters.help_zh: 服装类型，如果上传需要上传tops/bottoms/dresses/tops_and_bottoms/shoes/hats，如果不上传即自动识别
parameters.name: cloth_type

parameters.help_en: Required. The image resolution. Valid values: 1K and 2K
parameters.help_zh: 必填，图像分辨率，选择1K或者2K
parameters.name: resolution
